CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_UserAccessMatrix_DID] AS
BEGIN


WITH TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix AS
(
	SELECT
	 BDU.UserID AS UserId
	,BDU.UserName AS UserName
	,BDU.UserRole AS UserRole
	,BDU.UserEmail AS UserEmail
	,BDU.BranchId AS BranchId
	,BDU.PCCCode AS ProfitCostCode
	,BDU.SourceSystemCode AS SourceCode
	,BDU.BankId AS BankId
	,BDU.INSERT_DTTM AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,BDU.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
	,BDUD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.DID_USERACCESSMATRIX_DELTA BDUD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.DID_USERACCESSMATRIX BDU ON coalesce(BDU.UserID,'') = coalesce(BDUD.UserID,'') 
	AND coalesce(BDU.UserName,'') = coalesce(BDUD.UserName,'')
	AND coalesce(BDU.UserRole,'') = coalesce(BDUD.UserRole,'') 
	AND coalesce(BDU.UserEmail,'') = coalesce(BDUD.UserEmail,'') 
	AND coalesce(BDU.BranchId,'') = coalesce(BDUD.BranchId,'') 
	AND coalesce(BDU.PCCCode,'') = coalesce(BDUD.PCCCode,'')
	AND coalesce(BDU.SourceSystemCode,'') = coalesce(BDUD.SourceSystemCode,'') 
	AND coalesce(BDU.BankId,'') = coalesce(BDUD.BankId,'')
	AND BDU.ISLATEST = '1'

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix FROM TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix;

WITH TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_SRC AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			UserId
			,UserName
			,UserRole
			,UserEmail
			,BranchId
			,ProfitCostCode
			,SourceCode
			,BankId
			,PeriodStartDate
			,PeriodEndDate
			,FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
			,UserId, UserName, UserRole, UserEmail, BranchId, ProfitCostCode, SourceCode, BankId, RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_TGT AS
(
	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
			UserId
			,UserName
			,UserRole
			,UserEmail
			,BranchId
			,ProfitCostCode
			,SourceCode
			,BankId
			,PeriodStartDate
			,PeriodEndDate
			,FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
			,UserId, UserName, UserRole, UserEmail, BranchId, ProfitCostCode, SourceCode, BankId
	FROM BNKM.UserAccessMatrix WHERE PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')
),

TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_DELTA AS
(
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.UserId,TGT.UserId) AS UserId
		,ISNULL(SRC.UserName,TGT.UserName) AS UserName
		,ISNULL(SRC.UserRole,TGT.UserRole) AS UserRole
		,ISNULL(SRC.UserEmail,TGT.UserEmail) AS UserEmail
		,ISNULL(SRC.BranchId,TGT.BranchId) AS BranchId
		,ISNULL(SRC.ProfitCostCode,TGT.ProfitCostCode) AS ProfitCostCode
		,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
		,ISNULL(SRC.BankId,TGT.BankId) AS BankId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
			ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_SRC SRC
	LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_TGT TGT
	ON  coalesce(SRC.UserID,'')           = coalesce(TGT.UserID,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.UserName,'')         = coalesce(TGT.UserName,'')
	AND coalesce(SRC.UserRole,'')         = coalesce(TGT.UserRole,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.UserEmail,'')        = coalesce(TGT.UserEmail,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.BranchId,'')         = coalesce(TGT.BranchId,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.ProfitCostCode,'')          = coalesce(TGT.ProfitCostCode,'')
	AND coalesce(SRC.SourceCode,'') = coalesce(TGT.SourceCode,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.BankId,'')           = coalesce(TGT.BankId,'')
	WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = dateadd(dd,-1,getDate()) 
FROM BNKM.UserAccessMatrix TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_DELTA DELTA 
	ON  coalesce(DELTA.UserID,'')           = coalesce(TGT.UserID,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.UserName,'')         = coalesce(TGT.UserName,'')
	AND coalesce(DELTA.UserRole,'')         = coalesce(TGT.UserRole,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.UserEmail,'')        = coalesce(TGT.UserEmail,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.BranchId,'')         = coalesce(TGT.BranchId,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.ProfitCostCode,'')          = coalesce(TGT.ProfitCostCode,'')
	AND coalesce(DELTA.SourceCode,'') = coalesce(TGT.SourceCode,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.BankId,'')           = coalesce(TGT.BankId,'')
	AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

--ON DELTA.UserId = TGT.UserId AND DELTA.UserName = TGT.UserName AND DELTA.UserRole = TGT.UserRole AND DELTA.UserEmail = TGT.UserEmail AND DELTA.BranchId = TGT.BranchId AND DELTA.ProfitCostCode = TGT.ProfitCostCode AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode AND DELTA.BankId = TGT.BankId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'

JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix SRC
	ON  coalesce(SRC.UserID,'')           = coalesce(TGT.UserID,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.UserName,'')         = coalesce(TGT.UserName,'')
	AND coalesce(SRC.UserRole,'')         = coalesce(TGT.UserRole,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.UserEmail,'')        = coalesce(TGT.UserEmail,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.BranchId,'')         = coalesce(TGT.BranchId,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.ProfitCostCode,'')          = coalesce(TGT.ProfitCostCode,'')
	AND coalesce(SRC.SourceCode,'') = coalesce(TGT.SourceCode,'') 
	AND coalesce(SRC.BankId,'')           = coalesce(TGT.BankId,'')
	WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate in ('9999-12-31')
--ON SRC.UserId = TGT.UserId AND SRC.UserName = TGT.UserName AND SRC.UserRole = TGT.UserRole AND SRC.UserEmail = TGT.UserEmail AND SRC.BranchId = TGT.BranchId AND SRC.ProfitCostCode = TGT.ProfitCostCode AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode AND SRC.BankId = TGT.BankId




--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.UserAccessMatrix ( 
UserId
,UserName
,UserRole
,UserEmail
,BranchId
,ProfitCostCode
,SourceCode
,BankId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT
 SRC.UserId AS UserId
,SRC.UserName AS UserName
,SRC.UserRole AS UserRole
,SRC.UserEmail AS UserEmail
,SRC.BranchId AS BranchId
,SRC.ProfitCostCode AS ProfitCostCode
,SRC.SourceCode AS SourceCode
,SRC.BankId AS BankId
,SRC.PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
,SRC.PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
--,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
--,STUFF(PeriodEndDate,1,27,'20991231') AS PeriodEndDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_DELTA DELTA
	ON  coalesce(DELTA.UserID,'')           = coalesce(SRC.UserID,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.UserName,'')         = coalesce(SRC.UserName,'')
	AND coalesce(DELTA.UserRole,'')         = coalesce(SRC.UserRole,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.UserEmail,'')        = coalesce(SRC.UserEmail,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.BranchId,'')         = coalesce(SRC.BranchId,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.ProfitCostCode,'')          = coalesce(SRC.ProfitCostCode,'')
	AND coalesce(DELTA.SourceCode,'') = coalesce(SRC.SourceCode,'') 
	AND coalesce(DELTA.BankId,'')           = coalesce(SRC.BankId,'')
	AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
--ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.UserId = SRC.UserId AND DELTA.UserName = SRC.UserName AND DELTA.UserRole = SRC.UserRole AND DELTA.UserEmail = SRC.UserEmail AND DELTA.BranchId = SRC.BranchId AND DELTA.ProfitCostCode = SRC.ProfitCostCode AND DELTA.BankId = SRC.BankId AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.UserAccessMatrix ( 
UserId
,UserName
,UserRole
,UserEmail
,BranchId
,ProfitCostCode
,SourceCode
,BankId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	 UserId AS UserId
	,UserName AS UserName
	,UserRole AS UserRole
	,UserEmail AS UserEmail
	,BranchId AS BranchId
	,ProfitCostCode AS ProfitCostCode
	,SourceCode AS SourceCode
	,BankId AS BankId
	,PeriodStartDate AS PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate AS PeriodEndDate
	,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'DID' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
	--,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	--,STUFF(PeriodEndDate,1,27,'20991231') AS PeriodEndDate
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_UserAccessMatrix_DELTA;

END
GO
